conditions.runtime: Distant Horizons 3.3.3 is present in the managed Forge 1.20.1 client and Chunky 1.3.146 remains available on the ordinary dedicated server

change.summary: Keep Chunky as a dedicated-server pregeneration tool and remove it from the managed client so Distant Horizons cannot call an uninitialized integrated-server Chunky provider

conditions: Distant Horizons 3.3.3 remains installed on the client and dedicated server
modifiers.notes: This changes only Chunky's distribution. Its dedicated-server JAR, configuration, saved task and operator commands remain unchanged.

cause.owner: Client/ManagedPack inventory and dedicated Server inventory

rationale.purpose: Prevent a repeatable integrated-server startup crash while preserving operator-controlled pregeneration on the dedicated server.
rationale.decision_source: The user reported a repeat client crash on 2026-11-19. The fresh crash report and installed bytecode show Distant Horizons calling ChunkyProvider.get during the first chunk promotion before ChunkyForge.onServerStarting creates the provider.

introduced.summary: Remove Chunky 1.3.146 from the managed client and retain the identical dedicated-server artifact and runtime state.

history.summary: Selected dedicated-server-only Chunky distribution after the installed Distant Horizons accessor crashed the integrated server before Chunky's provider lifecycle completed.

relations: managed client -> Distant Horizons without the optional Chunky accessor target
dedicated server -> unchanged Chunky pregeneration commands and saved runtime state
notes: No JEM fallback or exception suppression is added because distribution owns the invalid client lifecycle combination.
Native AutoModpack publication removes the exact client JAR instead of mutating the installed profile directly.
No registry IDs or gameplay values change.
unresolved: Player acceptance remains pending until the user relaunches Test JustEnoughMods and opens an integrated world.
